name: Shaphat
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The Lord sent Elijah back to the wilderness of Damascus to anoint Hazael to be king over Syria, Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel, and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah to be prophet in his room. Him that escaped the sword of Hazael would Jehu slay, and him that escaped Jehu would Elisha slay.

Jehoshaphat asks whether there is not a prophet of the Lord that they may inquire of the Lord by him. One of the king of Israel's servants answers that Elisha the son of Shaphat is there, who poured water on the hands of Elijah.

note.label: 2 Kings 3: Three Kings and the Water in the Ditches
